note: The weekly FAN LIFE feature film (owner, 2.11.2026). One feature a week, in this order. Words are the feature's real rules (CLAUDE.md rules 21, 103, 107, 110, 112, 123, gates.ts) — never a promise the game does not keep. `shots` are captured from the live site on a phone screen; `click` is a regex of the visible text pressed before that shot ({club} = the club's name; read off the live pages 2.11.2026) (skipped when it is not on the page).

trivia.name: Trivia
trivia.title: Only real fans get past stage three | FAN LIFE Trivia

beats.say: Every club on FAN LIFE has its own trivia wing, written from that club's own history. Not a generic quiz. Your club.
Twelve questions in three stages, and every stage is harder than the last. You get three lives, and a wrong answer costs one.
Answer quickly and the combo grows, up to four times. The clock is part of the game, so thinking fast is how you score big.
Four levels, from easy to expert. Every answer is checked against the club's archive, and every question shows its source.

trivia.hook: How well do you really know your club?

blind-cow.name: Blind Cow
blind-cow.title: Name the player before the last clue | FAN LIFE Blind Cow

beats.say: Blind Cow is a guessing game. One player from your club's history, hidden behind his clues.
The clues come one at a time: where he's from, where he played, a season, a shirt number. Every clue is sourced.
The fewer clues you need, the better your time. A wrong guess costs you seconds.
Play it solo, or send a friend the same player and race them, clue for clue.

blind-cow.hook: One player. Five clues. How many do you need?

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.title: Put your club's biggest nights in order | FAN LIFE Timeline

beats.say: Timeline takes the dates your club lived through: finals, titles, nights in Europe.
Each card is a real moment from the archive. Your job is to put it in the right place in history.
Get the order right and the line grows. Get it wrong and the archive shows you where it really belongs.

timeline.hook: You remember the night. Do you remember the year?

royal-rumble.name: Royal Rumble
royal-rumble.title: Build your club's dream team on a budget | FAN LIFE Royal Rumble

beats.say: Royal Rumble: build a team from every player your club has ever had, from the first season to today.
You pick the line, and the slot machine deals you three players from three price tiers. Pick one, and watch the budget.
Three spins for the whole draft. A legend costs five million, and the budget is hard. No cheating it.
Then your team plays, and the same link lets a friend draft against you.

royal-rumble.hook: Your club's all-time eleven. Your budget. Your call.

legends-manager.name: Legends Manager
legends-manager.title: Manage your club's legends for a whole season | FAN LIFE Legends Manager

beats.say: Legends Manager: take your club's legends, and play a full season with them.
You draft the squad from the club's own history, inside a budget. Every player is rated in stars, never in numbers.
Then the matches play live. At half time, on the hour and with fifteen to go, you decide what changes.
Pick a captain, survive the injuries and the cards, and see if your legends can win the league.

legends-manager.hook: Your club's legends. One season. You're the manager.

memory.name: Memory
memory.title: The memory game made of your club's history | FAN LIFE Memory

beats.say: The classic memory game, but every card is a piece of your club's history.
Turn two cards. If they belong together, a player and his season, a night and its score, they stay open.
Every pair is a sourced fact. Clear the board, and you've learned something about your own club.

memory.hook: Your club's history, face down. How fast can you match it?

away-days.name: Away Days
away-days.title: Every away ground your club ever played at, on one map | FAN LIFE Away Days

beats.say: Away Days is a map of every ground your club has played at abroad, built only from verified matches.
Tap a ground and you get the night: the date, the score, the competition, and the stadium itself.
Were you there? Stamp it. Your away days become your own map, and you can follow it trip by trip.

away-days.hook: Where did your club take you?

xi.name: All-time XI
xi.title: Pick your club's all-time eleven | FAN LIFE

beats.say: The argument every supporter has had: who makes your club's all-time eleven?
Pick from every player in the archive, each in his real position and his real years.
Build it, share it, and let the terrace argue about it.

xi.hook: Your club's all-time eleven. Eleven names. Go.
